title: Build a radix-2 FFT and four windows
brief: Build the recursive radix-2 FFT, the cosine-sum windows in periodic and symmetric form, and a function that measures each window's main lobe and side lobes.
hints: In fft_radix2, combine the halves with np.concatenate([E + T, E - T]), where T is the twiddles times the odd half.
n & (n - 1) is 0 exactly when a positive integer n is a power of two.
A periodic window divides by n, a symmetric one by n - 1. scipy calls the rectangular window boxcar.
In leakage, normalize by the value at index 0 before taking decibels, so the main lobe peaks at 0 dB.
The first null is the first index k where the next value is no longer smaller than spectrum[k].
